voce: List of NFL career sacks leaders
titolo: List of NFL career sacks leaders
wikitext:
{{Short description|None}} {{Use mdy dates|date=September 2025}} This is a list of [[National Football League]] (NFL) players who have reached the 100-[[Quarterback sack|sack]] milestone. The NFL began to keep track of sacks in 1982, with 46 players having reached the milestone in that time. Using unofficial record-keeping (dating back to 1960), an additional 21 players have finished with 100 or more career sacks, leading to a total of 67 players. Although other major NFL records get broken every season, the league's career sack record remains difficult to challenge. In September 2025, NFL reporter for ''USA Today'' Jacob Camenker wrote that approaching [[Bruce Smith]]'s 200 sacks would require "something special" and that the record "seems highly unlikely" to be broken.{{cite web |title=NFL's all-time sack leaders: Bruce Smith, Reggie White top list |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nfl/2025/09/11/nfl-all-time-sack-leaders-history-bruce-smith-reggie-white/86085259007/ |website=[[USA Today]] |last1=Camenker |first1=Jacob}} ==List of NFL players with 100 official career sacks== [[File:Bruce Smith Pro Bowl cropped.jpg|thumb|[[Bruce Smith]] has the most sacks in NFL history.]] [[File:Von Miller (Broncos) ITN.jpg|thumb|alt=Von Miller in a Denver Broncos jersey and no helmet.|[[Von Miller]] is the current leader in career sacks among active players.]] {| class="wikitable plainrowheaders" border="1" |+ Key |- ! scope="col" style="width:75px" | Symbol ! scope="col" style="width:450px" | Meaning |- ! scope="row" style="text-align:center;" | '''Sacks''' | The total number of sacks the player recorded |- ! scope="row" style="text-align:center; background:#FFFF99;" | {{dagger}} | [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]] member |- ! scope="row" style="text-align:center; background-color:#cfecec;" | ^ | The player is an active player |} ''Updated through Week 10 of the {{NFL year|2026}} NFL season.'' {| class="wikitable sortable " style="text-align:center; |+National Football League players with over 100 official sacks |- ! scope=col | Rank ! scope=col | Pos. ! scope=col | Player ! scope=col | Seasons by team ! scope=col | Sacks ! scope=col class="unsortable" | {{abbr|Refs|References}} |- ! scope=row | 1 |DE | style="background-color:#FFFF99;" | [[Bruce Smith]]{{dagger}} | [[Buffalo Bills]] ({{NFL Year|1985|1999}})

After examining the play-by-play records of every NFL team as well as game film at NFL films they compiled a list of players with 100 sacks beginning in 1960. By including the unofficial sack/dump records from 1960 to 1981, the following players also qualify as members of the 100-Sack Club.{{cite news |title=Sack Story: Setting the Record Straight on All of Those QB Takedowns |url=http://archive.profootballweekly.com/content/archives/features_1999/turney_062600.asp |date=June 26, 2000 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081105075549/http://archive.profootballweekly.com/content/archives/features_1999/turney_062600.asp |archive-date=November 5, 2008 |url-status=dead |work=[[Pro Football Weekly]] |last1=Turney |first1=John |access-date=November 8, 2017}}{{cite web |title=Pre-1982 Sacks Added to Pro Football Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/blog/2021/07/pre-1982-sacks-added-to-pro-football-reference/ |website=[[Sports Reference]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220120193014/https://www.sports-reference.com/blog/2021/07/pre-1982-sacks-added-to-pro-football-reference/ |archive-date=January 20, 2022 |url-status=live |access-date=September 12, 2021}} Additionally, linebackers (LB) [[Lawrence Taylor]] and [[Rickey Jackson]] played their rookie seasons in 1981, which was the last season that sacks were not officially tracked. Taylor had 9.5 and Jackson had 8.0 sacks that season, which would increase their totals to 142.0 and 136.0 sacks, respectively.
